_comment: The sign-up forms' consent texts and minimum age (CHG-009). The templates render these exact texts, and the Pages Functions (website/lib/signup.js) hash the same texts into each consent event, so the two can never drift. minAge is a founder and counsel decision that is still open (UNP-73 CF-1); 18 is the default. Change a text and the policyVersion together. noticeEffective is the effective date of privacy notice version 0.4, which /privacy/ shows only while formsOpen is on; it is the founder's to set before sign-ups open in production (empty renders "date to be set").

texts.signing: I agree with the pledge above. My signature counts once I confirm by email, and my name, if I give one, is never shown.
texts.email_updates_pledge: Also email me occasional Uncost updates. This is optional and separate from signing, and I can unsubscribe anytime.
texts.email_updates: Yes — email me Uncost updates. We use your address for updates only: we won’t sell your data or use it for partisan targeting, and you can unsubscribe anytime.
